verdict.rationale: Zep is API-first: core memory operations (add messages, retrieve context, delete users/edges/nodes, RTBF, custom entity types) are all documented as API calls, and zepctl exposes 'full access to Zep' for admin tasks (users, threads, Context Graphs, data ops) from the terminal, suggesting broad parity. However, there is no explicit statement that the dashboard/UI has zero API-exclusive features or vice versa, and governance/ABAC policy configuration is described mainly as a dashboard/console feature without confirming full API equivalence. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every UI-configurable setting (e.g., ABAC policies, dashboard RBAC setup) has a documented API equivalent, and independent/hands-on verification of full UI-API parity.
